Subject: Request: temporary Net60 + VAT handling for BluePeak pilot

Camila —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. BluePeak is excited to kick off the pilot next month, but we're managing a near-term cash pressure window across our EU entity and need a short-term extension on payment terms.

Specifically, can Redwood support Net60 for the first 2 months of the pilot (covering invoices dated Apr/May) with a commitment to revert to Net30 thereafter? We can provide a PO (attached) and propose a 10% pre-authorized debit on the first invoice as a good-faith holdback.

Also: our EU finance team needs the invoice to reference our VAT sub-accounting code (BP-EU-41) and confirm reverse-charge handling where applicable. If you can confirm the tax wording and an SAP supplier ID to route payments, that would speed our AP process.

I've attached the PO and a short VAT summary. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Oliver

CFO, BluePeak Labs

Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net60 + VAT handling for BluePeak pilot

Oliver —

Appreciate the context and the PO. We can accommodate a short-term credit accommodation but need to formalize a few guardrails so this doesn't materially increase our risk. High-level proposal below — please review and let us know what you can accept: 

- Term: Net60 for invoices dated Apr and May 2026 only; revert to Net30 starting Jun 1, 2026.
- Credit staging: Redwood will approve up to a £150k credit corridor for Apr/May. Any usage beyond that requires an additional PO or an approved credit increase.
- Holdback: 10% pre-authorized debit on first invoice (applied to final invoice of pilot) — Redwood will hold as a retainage and release within 30 days after pilot acceptance.
- VAT & invoicing: We will include your VAT sub-account code (BP-EU-41) on the invoice and mark eligible charges under reverse-charge language. Kimberly (cc'd) will provide the exact invoice line wording needed for SAP matching.
- Supplier routing: we will provision a temporary SAP supplier ID for BluePeak and share the remit details by next business day once finance signs off.
- Evidence: We'll need your signed PO (attached) and a short confirmation of EU reverse-charge applicability from your tax team (can be PDF or email).

If that looks reasonable I can draft a short amendment to the SOW and payment terms (DocuSign) so finance has an auditable trail. If you prefer, we can instead do a 30-min call Monday to agree final language.

Thanks — I want to keep the pilot moving but protect both sides.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0198

1) Credit corridor confirmation: we will issue a temporary credit line up to GBP 150,000 for Apr/May. Please confirm BluePeak's expected monthly run-rate (approx token/usage spend) so we can ensure limits align.

2) Currency & FX: invoices will be issued in GBP. If BluePeak prefers EUR payments, we need bank details and whether you plan to absorb FX or request Redwood to invoice EUR (we can but it requires an updated SOW).

3) VAT evidence: file named 'BP_VAT_EUVoucher.xlsx' is acceptable as initial evidence. For reverse-charge we require a short signed attestation from your VAT contact confirming intra-community services and the VAT number to appear on the invoice.

4) PO & DocuSign: once you confirm run-rate and VAT attestation we'll send an amendment via DocuSign with the Net60 dates and holdback clause.
